items.name: editorial-card
items.title: Editorial Card
items.description: A semantic, minimal article surface with optional index, eyebrow, heading, and content.

meta.installation: Copy editorial-card.tsx into your component directory, import editorial-card.css once, and ensure React 18 or 19 is installed.
meta.reducedMotion: No animation is used; the component remains static for all motion preferences.

items.name: cinematic-hero
items.title: Cinematic Hero
items.description: A sculptural editorial hero with sequenced type, pointer-responsive depth, and a warm celestial composition.

meta.installation: Copy component.tsx and useReducedMotion.ts into your project, then import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
meta.reducedMotion: The pointer response is disabled and entrance transitions are reduced to an effectively static state when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

items.name: interactive-character-hero
items.title: Interactive Character Hero
items.description: An original illustrated observatory automaton turns toward the pointer through eight art-directed frames.

meta.installation: Copy component.tsx, CursorCharacter.tsx, and useReducedMotion.ts into your component directory, copy the portrait assets to assets/, and import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
meta.reducedMotion: CursorCharacter holds the center image and disables directional frame tracking when reduced motion is preferred. Hero entrance effects are reduced by CSS.

items.name: kinetic-typography-hero
items.title: Kinetic Typography Hero
items.description: A monumental typographic composition with word-by-word entrance timing, sharp print contrast, and optional scroll registration.

meta.installation: Copy component.tsx and useReducedMotion.ts into your project, then import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
meta.reducedMotion: Word entrance animations are effectively immediate, scroll listeners and scroll-derived transforms are disabled, and the text layout remains unchanged.
